 Minister of Transportation Prioritizes Prevention of Transportation Accidents during the Christmas and Rainy Season Holidays 
 10 November 2026, 08:46 | Editorial Team 
 Teddy Kurniawan 
 Reporter 
 Teddy Kurniawan 
 Editor 
 Minister of Transportation Prioritizes Prevention of Transportation Accidents during the Christmas and Rainy Season. (VOI Video Graphics Team)
 Share:
 Jakarta - Christmas and New Year holidays (Nataru) are coming soon. The government prioritizes transportation safety which coincides with the rainy season.
 This was conveyed by Minister of Transportation (Menhub) Dudy Purwagandhi at the Presidential Palace Complex, Jakarta, Monday, November 9.
 According to Dudy, the Ministry of Transportation will focus on the readiness of all modes of transportation, both land, sea, air, and railways.
 Apart from Nataru's preparations, Dudy also explained the cancellation of PT. KAI's plan to import used electric train (KRL) from Japan. Dudy admitted that he had not met with KAI President Director Bobby Rasyidin to discuss the issue.
 Previously, KAI canceled plans to import used KRL from Japan and chose to procure a new series. The company needs an additional 23 KRL series for Jabodetabek services, with eight of them being urgent needs.
 KAI plans to involve domestic industries, including PT Industri Kereta Api (INKA), as well as opening up opportunities for cooperation with foreign manufacturers.
